headline: GTA 6 preload opens today, Nvidia launches an internal probe into reports about Jensen Huang, Anthropic's IPO edges closer at a lower valuation, and Ferrari go digging into the SF-26 before Vegas.

upcoming.what: GTA 6 preload opens on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S (up to 212 GB)
SpaceX Starship Flight 15 target date, attempting ship and booster catches; still awaiting FAA approval (time TBC)
UFC 334, Madison Square Garden: Gane vs Hokit (heavyweight title) and Harrison vs Nunes. Prelims 00:00, main card 02:00 Sun 15 Nov Irish time
Leonid meteor shower peak; best from about 01:00 to dawn
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
Polaris 40, Southampton: Tonon vs McNally. UFC Doha: Prochazka vs Stirling. F1 Las Vegas GP lights out around 04:00 Sun 22 Nov Irish time (TBC)

items.headline: Nvidia opens internal investigation into reports about Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia's board launched a probe after reports about a personal relationship involving its CEO and a suspected Chinese intelligence asset; the board says it has no reason to think company secrets were exposed. The stock lagged a broader tech rebound on Monday.

items.headline: Anthropic still aiming for a Nasdaq listing this month
items.summary: Per a WSJ report, Anthropic plans to list as 'ANT' soon, though the expected valuation has reportedly slipped from around $2 trillion to roughly $1-1.25 trillion amid the recent AI stock selloff.

items.headline: Starship Flight 15 waits on the FAA for Friday
items.summary: SpaceX is still targeting 13 November for its dual-catch attempt of both Super Heavy and the ship, pending regulatory sign-off.

items.headline: Mars may still hold pockets of magma
items.summary: New research suggests that while Mars' molten interior is long gone, isolated magma chambers could persist beneath the surface.

items.headline: Nuking an asteroid could work, with a catch
items.summary: A new study looks at using a nuclear blast to deflect a threatening asteroid and the complications that come with it.

items.headline: GTA 6 preload opens today
items.summary: Rockstar's preload window starts today on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with downloads of up to 212 GB ahead of the 19 November launch. Clear some space.

items.headline: Watchlist: quiet
items.summary: No fresh news on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands in the last 24-48 hours; the latest Cyberpunk 2 item is a late-October job listing hinting at multiplayer.

items.headline: Mica Galvão returns with a win at The Crown
items.summary: Mica won on his return at the 2026 IBJJF Crown, while Sarah Galvão went back-to-back. Erich Munis and Gabi Pessanha again took the heaviest divisions, and João Mendes and Fellipe Andrew also won their brackets.

items.headline: UFC 334 this Saturday: start times for Ireland
items.summary: Gane defends heavyweight gold against Hokit and Nunes comes out of retirement to face Harrison at MSG. Main card is 02:00 Sunday Irish time (prelims midnight), on TNT Sports. No Irish or UK fighters confirmed on the card.

items.headline: Ferrari to investigate the SF-26 before Vegas
items.summary: A 'devastated' Hamilton finished ninth in Brazil after tyre and oversteer struggles, and Ferrari will dig into the car's behaviour before Las Vegas.

items.headline: Lawson edging towards a 2027 Racing Bulls stay
items.summary: After seventh at Interlagos, Lawson is reportedly increasingly likely to keep his seat, with an announcement expected in the coming weeks.

items.headline: Albon penalised for unsafe rejoin
items.summary: Stewards gave Albon a five-second penalty and two licence points for rejoining in front of Gasly; Williams are now five races without a point.
